title: Sean Payton will be Drew Brees's Hall of Fame presenter

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Sean Payton will be Drew Brees's Hall of Fame presenter
sources.description: Drew Brees and Sean Payton teamed up to win a lot of games with the Saints and Brees will tap into that history at next month's Hall of Fame induction ceremony.
